messages:
incident-bot: Pager — metering: latebucket surge detected for emit-collector-eu1, token delta vs ledger > 150% over last 15m. Alerting on-call team.

maria (oncall): saw it. investigating now. first check: are we replaying?

aj (sre): looking at emit queue, consumer lag ~12m, backlog growth. redis repro: `LPUSH` spike on emit:queue.

ana (billing): while you check, customers started getting overage flags ~10m ago. which segments impacted?

maria (oncall): quick grep: affected namespaces: orgs starting with acme-*, beta-accounts. sending note to CS.

jackson (cs): received 2 customer tickets. notifying priority customers: Acme & BrightCo. they saw unexpected billing alerts.

aj (sre): stacktrace from collector: `panic: duplicate-emit-id` followed by retries — looks like emitter retried idempotency failure + replay flood.

sam (platform): rolling throttle on emitter ingress now: `kubectl patch deployment emit-collector --patch '{"spec":{"template":{"spec":{"containers":[{"name":"collector","env":[{"name":"EMIT_RATE_LIMIT","value":"500"}]}]}}}}'` — will rate-limit to reduce storm.

maria (oncall): +1 to throttle. also toggling shadow-write off for billing pipeline to stop noisy overflags. patching feature flag: `billing.shadow_write=false`.

ana (billing): confirmed shadow-write off. we still need to reconcile counts for customers — will this pause live billing?

aj (sre): shadow off prevents new noisy writes; ledger consumer still processing backlog. starting consumer slow-drain (concurrency -> 2).

maria (oncall): mitigation checklist:
- throttled emitter ingress (sam) : done
- disabled billing shadow writes (maria) : done
- reduced consumer concurrency to stop replay amplification (aj) : in progress
- collecting raw emit samples for reconciliation (ana) : requested

devex-bot: Attached: snippet of last 200 emits from emit-collector-eu1: `curl -s http://collector/logs?limit=200 | jq .` (redacted)

ana (billing): gathering reconciliation keys now. if we need to rollback customer flags, we can bulk-clear overage flags for affected orgs; prepping a rollback playbook.

jackson (cs): telling Acme ops we've throttled ingest and are working on reconciliation; will provide ETA in 30m. they asked if credits will be issued.

aj (sre): quick note: root cause looks like emitter CV deploy from 02:12 that removed idempotency header check. pushing a patch to re-enable header validation and cut a hotfix. patch ready, will deploy to canary.

maria (oncall): go for canary. keep traffic on reduced rate.

sam (platform): canary deploy done to 2 pods. monitoring for duplicate-id spike.

aj (sre): canary looks clean for 5m, duplicate-id events down 98%. preparing rollout to eu1 full.

maria (oncall): after full rollout, re-enable shadow-write for short window to reconcile then bulk-scrub synthetic overflags. Coordinate with billing & cs.

ana (billing): agree. plan: 1) full rollout 2) re-enable shadow 3) capture diff for 15m 4) run reconciliation, and if drift > threshold, automatically clear overage flags and notify customers.

jackson (cs): will draft customer note: short incident summary + mitigation + credit offer if billed. will wait for final reconciliation numbers.

maria (oncall): status update for pg: mitigations applied, canary hotfix succeeded, throttles in place, shadow-write off. impact: customer visible overage flags triggered for ~2% of active accounts (mostly beta and ACME family). working on reconciliation ETA ~45-60m.

incident-bot: Incident annotated: severity P2 — billing telemetry anomaly. Incident lead: maria (oncall). Handing off to daytime ops at next rotation.

jackson (cs): confirming Acme notified. keeping channel open for updates. :thumbsup:

maria (oncall): last check: consumer backlog down from 12m -> 3m, duplicate emits negligible. monitoring will continue. closing loop in 1h with postmortem owners: aj (sre), ana (billing), sam (platform).

devex-bot: Created ticket INF-4587 for reconciliation + postmortem.
